school.note: Cutscene backdrop only; playable schoolyard arena is separate.

home.note: One caregiver visual; do not map separate actual caregiver identities to one art ID without review. Fish image contains a decorative fantasy pellet; not a separate physics ball.

training.note: Only show characters actually authored at this session. Rival practice portraits are available, not permission to put rivals in the player team.

match.note: Match kit persists through the event; affiliation and opponents come from canonical game data.

rules: Names never become asset keys or paths.
Unknown mapping is an explicit gap, not a random fallback.
Outfit is fixed throughout an authored event.
Never modify soccer or story effect state on art load.
Only boy OR girl represents the player at one time.
Source v0.7 defines Alex separately from player.
Current controls SOW supersedes older gestures; graphics must not revert it.
Scene cast comes from scene-visual-map.json plus canonical evidence; available wardrobe does not grant attendance.
authorityNotice: Available wardrobe variants, not cast/scene eligibility. Use scene-visual-map.json and canonical scene evidence.

runtimeSelection.unknownIdentity: visible named neutral fallback; no substitution with another cast member
runtimeSelection.outfitRevision: pin in scene occurrence; replay uses the recorded revision
runtimeSelection.membership: canonical teamId at event; never inferred from kit color
runtimeSelection.transfer: keep face/hair; use a supported kit for the new membership or mark an art gap; never reuse a rival kit silently
